name: InterContinental Resort Bali
positioning: InterContinental Bali Resort: a beachfront resort on Jimbaran Bay in southern Bali, set in tropical gardens with the ambiance of a Balinese village
best_for: Travelers wanting a Jimbaran Bay beach base with a choice of pools and a spa
Families wanting a family pool, babysitting and children's activities

facts.text: The resort sits on Jimbaran Bay on Bali's southern coast.
The resort is set in lush tropical gardens alongside a sugar-white sand beach.
The resort is designed to evoke the ambiance of a tranquil Balinese village.
Rooms, suites and private villas are spread across six separate wings that blend modern convenience with traditional Balinese architecture.
The Nirvana pool, the resort's largest, overlooks Jimbaran Bay.
Other pools include the Balinese Bath, Fountain and family 'Fun' pools, plus a Club pool exclusive to InterContinental Club guests.
Spa Uluwatu offers hydrotherapy, a sauna and steam bathing.
Spa Uluwatu treatments include body scrubs, body wraps, facials and foot reflexology.
Club InterContinental offers a lounge experience built around privacy, exclusivity and intuitive service.
KO is the resort's signature Japanese restaurant, blending Balinese architecture with Japanese gardens.
Bella Cucina serves a Mediterranean menu, with al fresco tables beside lantern-lit tropical gardens or a private indoor glass conservatory.
The resort offers babysitting and children's activities on site.

highlights.text: The resort was the first of its kind built on these Jimbaran Bay shores, overlooking the sunsets.
The Classica Villa measures 378 square meters and has one king bed and two single beds.
The concierge can arrange a traditional fishing boat trip out on Jimbaran Bay.
Sunset Beach Bar & Grill sits among coconut palms on the beach of Jimbaran Bay, for drinks, dining and sunsets.
Rooms and suites may include a balcony, garden view and a separate bath and walk-in shower.

considerations.text: The resort is about a 15-minute drive from Ngurah Rai International Airport.
Uluwatu Temple, popular for viewing the sunset, is about 30 minutes from the resort.
WhataHotel notes it is a large resort, with walking distances between facilities.
